# O18: The gift

Market: US. Winner since 2026-10. Pain: hard to find a useful gift.

## Hook (0–3 s)

Spoken: "Gift idea for the person who always has mismatched socks"
On screen: "For your mismatched friend"
Visual: friend at a party showing two different socks, everyone laughing.

## Body (3–22 s)

"We all know one. Two different socks, every single day. SockLock pairs snap
together with a small magnet, so they never get separated in the wash. It's a gift
they'll actually use every morning."

Visual: gift box opening, pair snapped together, the same friend later wearing a
matching pair.

## CTA (22–28 s)

"Five pairs for $29. Take the quiz and send it as a gift."
On screen: "Send it as a gift"
